label: BUG
title: Security Policies | Idle timeout also signs out sessions that are in active use

panels.caption: TAVI — Security Policies › Idle timeout help: "the clock resets on every request".
Zoho — Setup › Security Policies opens Zoho Directory, which is not enabled in our org. Not enabled (it would change the org), so Zoho's session behaviour was not checked live.
TAVI — request trace with the idle limit at 2 min: the busy session (a request every 30 s) is signed out at 180 s; Login History still says active.
